scope: Gate 2 additive schema implementation for the missing consumer receipts, canonical player identity bridge, and shared app-wiring claim store; runtime consumer integration remains blocking.

globalPolicies.foreignKey: Every FK column has the referenced PK/UK column's exact name, SQL type, length, charset, collation and unsigned attribute; multiple semantic player roles use participant rows.

audit.updateRule: an update preserves INSERT_USER and INSERT_TIME and changes only UPDATE_USER and UPDATE_TIME among audit columns
audit.checkLimitation: A row CHECK can validate the CHAR(19) timestamp format and allowed values, but cannot distinguish INSERT from UPDATE or compare OLD and NEW rows; equality-at-insert and UPDATE-only behavior require the shared provider or DB triggers and runtime tests before promotion.

globalPolicies.typedAssetReference: Polymorphic ledgers use an asset_type discriminator plus exactly one typed definition/owned-instance FK; generic asset_id, object_id, CODE and display-name identity are forbidden.
globalPolicies.definitionOwnership: Receipts, ledgers, crosswalks and participant rows store references, deltas and occurrence state only; names, descriptions, grades, prices, base values, enhancement rules and common effects remain in definition tables.
globalPolicies.identityResolution: Join external_identities by its persisted (provider_code, external_user_id) unique key, then join the crosswalk to canonical_players.player_id. Never cast or copy legacy BIGINT identity and never infer identity from display_name.

boundaryAlignment.storageModel: request_namespace, entrypoint_kind, external_request_id, request_key and request_identity_fingerprint are separate columns; ambiguous concatenated identity storage is forbidden
boundaryAlignment.identityFormulaLimitation: CHECK validates namespace, external id and lowercase fingerprint shape only; the shared provider must derive request_key and SHA-256 of the exact whitespace-free UTF-8 JSON tuple before insert and must reject caller-supplied drift.
boundaryAlignment.replay: same UNIQUE request_identity_fingerprint and payload_fingerprint returns the persisted route, claim state, result_json and error_code; payload drift fails closed
boundaryAlignment.stateTransitionLimitation: CHECK validates the current state only; allowed CLAIMED->MUTATION_STARTED/COMPLETED/FAILED and MUTATION_STARTED->COMPLETED/FAILED transitions require OLD/NEW comparison in the shared provider or a DB trigger/procedure.
boundaryAlignment.leaseAndFencing: MUTATION execution requires the current lease_token and lease_generation; stale generations fail closed, terminal rows clear lease fields, and an all-NULL legacy transition bundle is storage-compatible only and must be drained or fenced before execution.
boundaryAlignment.recovery: Expired MUTATION_STARTED claims move through PENDING/RECOVERED/FAILED recovery with attempt_count and recovery_code; READ_ONLY routes cannot enter MUTATION_STARTED.
boundaryAlignment.atomicTypedReceipt: Only an effect_mode=MUTATION terminal app-wiring row requires exactly one typed operation receipt link in the same controlled transaction. READ_ONLY and REJECT terminal outcomes are valid without a link. Replay returns the persisted terminal DTO and, when a link exists, verifies result_fingerprint against the selected typed operation at runtime.

checks.expression: route = 'REJECT' OR command_code IS NOT NULL OR handler_key IS NOT NULL
effect_mode IS NULL OR effect_mode IN ('READ_ONLY','MUTATION')
effect_mode IS NULL OR route NOT IN ('SHADOW','REJECT') OR effect_mode = 'READ_ONLY'
effect_mode IS NULL OR claim_state <> 'MUTATION_STARTED' OR effect_mode = 'MUTATION'
(claim_state IN ('CLAIMED','MUTATION_STARTED') AND result_json IS NULL AND error_code IS NULL) OR claim_state IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED')
(claim_state = 'COMPLETED' AND result_json IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NULL) OR claim_state <> 'COMPLETED'
(claim_state = 'FAILED' AND result_json IS NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL) OR claim_state <> 'FAILED'
claim_state NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') OR (lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_time IS NULL)
(lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_time IS NULL) OR (lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_time IS NOT NULL)
lease_token IS NULL OR lease_token REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
(lease_generation IS NULL AND attempt_count IS NULL) OR (lease_generation >= 0 AND attempt_count >= 1)
recovery_status IS NULL OR recovery_status IN ('NONE','PENDING','RECOVERED','FAILED')
recovery_status IS NULL OR (recovery_status = 'NONE' AND recovery_code IS NULL) OR (recovery_status IN ('PENDING','RECOVERED','FAILED') AND recovery_code IS NOT NULL)

(effect_mode IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_generation IS NULL AND lease_expires_time IS NULL AND attempt_count IS NULL AND recovery_status IS NULL AND recovery_code IS NULL) OR (effect_mode IS NOT NULL AND lease_generation IS NOT NULL AND attempt_count IS NOT NULL AND recovery_status IS NOT NULL)

recovery_status IS NULL OR (recovery_status = 'NONE' AND (claim_state IN ('CLAIMED','COMPLETED','FAILED') OR (claim_state = 'MUTATION_STARTED' AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_generation = 0))) OR (recovery_status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') AND claim_state = 'MUTATION_STARTED') OR (recovery_status = 'RECOVERED' AND claim_state IN ('CLAIMED','COMPLETED','FAILED'))

tables.runtimeValidation: For an effect_mode=MUTATION terminal row, exactly one selected heterogeneous operation receipt link and result_fingerprint equality are enforced by the shared provider in the same controlled transaction. READ_ONLY and REJECT terminal rows remain valid without a link; cross-table CHECKs cannot express this conditional existence rule.

(item_id IS NOT NULL) + (currency_id IS NOT NULL) + (owned_furniture_id IS NOT NULL) + (owned_equipment_id IS NOT NULL) + (owned_mini_pet_id IS NOT NULL) + (owned_pet_skill_id IS NOT NULL) = 1

(item_id IS NOT NULL) + (currency_id IS NOT NULL) + (furniture_id IS NOT NULL) + (equipment_id IS NOT NULL) + (pet_id IS NOT NULL) + (mini_pet_id IS NOT NULL) + (member_title_id IS NOT NULL) + (pet_title_id IS NOT NULL) + (mini_pet_title_id IS NOT NULL) + (pet_skill_id IS NOT NULL) + (package_id IS NOT NULL) = 1

(asset_type='ITEM' AND item_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='CURRENCY' AND currency_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='FURNITURE' AND furniture_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='EQUIPMENT' AND equipment_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='PET' AND pet_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='MINI_PET' AND mini_pet_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='MEMBER_TITLE' AND member_title_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='PET_TITLE' AND pet_title_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='MINI_PET_TITLE' AND mini_pet_title_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='PET_SKILL' AND pet_skill_id IS NOT NULL) OR (asset_type='PACKAGE' AND package_id IS NOT NULL)
